Container.Name: immich-memories
Container.Overview: Make films from your Immich library. NAS setup: allow 4 GiB RAM and 25 GB persistent state plus finished films. Not yet tested on Unraid; please report results in issue #1801. The UI holds your library API key. Localhost-only by default. Enable BOTH authentication fields before exposing it to your LAN. Keep bridge networking; host networking bypasses the private port binding.

Config.Name: Immich URL
Config.Description: Required: reachable Immich server URL, not localhost inside this container.

Config.Name: Immich API key
Config.Description: Required: your Immich API key. Never share an exported configured template.

Config.Name: Configuration and model cache
Config.Description: Persistent state and model cache. Directory must be writable by UID/GID 1000.

Config.Name: Finished films
Config.Description: Persistent finished films. Directory must be writable by UID/GID 1000.

Config.Name: UI username
Config.Description: Set BOTH username and password before publishing the UI beyond localhost.

Config.Name: UI password
Config.Description: Use a strong unique password; set the username too.

Config.Name: Settings encryption key
Config.Description: Optional random secret of at least 32 characters. Required to save credentials through Settings; keep it stable and backed up.
